name: 千鸟
description: 冲刺到同一行或同一列6格内1个空格，对路径上的所有敌人造成100%攻击力的物理伤害，并使其定身1回合。
targetText: 同一行或同一列6格内1个空格
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var pos = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 6, filter: 'all' }); if (!pos || pos.needsTargetSelection) return pos; if (pos.x !== caster.x && pos.y !== caster.y) return { success: false, message: '千鸟只能冲刺至同一行或同一列的格子' }; var dist = Math.abs(pos.x - caster.x) + Math.abs(pos.y - caster.y); if (dist === 0 || dist > 6) return { success: false, message: '目标距离必须在1-6格内' }; var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === pos.x && item.y === pos.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable) return { success: false, message: '目标格不可行走' }; if (battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === pos.x && piece.y === pos.y; })) return { success: false, message: '目标位置已有棋子' }; var enemies = battle.pieces.filter(function(piece) { if (piece.currentHp <= 0 || piece.ownerPlayerId === caster.ownerPlayerId) return false; if (pos.x === caster.x) return piece.x === caster.x && piece.y > Math.min(caster.y, pos.y) && piece.y < Math.max(caster.y, pos.y); return piece.y === caster.y && piece.x > Math.min(caster.x, pos.x) && piece.x < Math.max(caster.x, pos.x); }); caster.x = pos.x; caster.y = pos.y; var damage = Math.round(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); if (enemies.length) { dealDamage(caster, enemies, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); enemies.forEach(function(enemy) { if (enemy.currentHp <= 0) return; var existing = enemy.statusTags && enemy.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'chidori-immobile'; }); if (existing) { existing.currentDuration = 1; existing.remainingDuration = 1; } else { addStatusEffectById(enemy.instanceId, { id: 'chidori-immobile-' + enemy.instanceId, name: '被千鸟贯穿', type: 'chidori-immobile', currentDuration: 1, remainingDuration: 1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, relatedRules: ['rule-chidori-immobile'] }); addRuleById(enemy.instanceId, 'rule-chidori-immobile'); } }); } return { success: true, message: caster.name + '发动千鸟，冲刺至(' + pos.x + ',' + pos.y + ')并贯穿' + enemies.length + '名敌人' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.round((piece.attack || 0) * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: '直线冲刺6格，对路径敌人造成' + damage + '点物理伤害并定身1回合。', expectedValues: { damage: damage, range: 6 } }; }
